spans.s:
कैशिक m. (-कः) Love, passion, lust.
 f. (-की) One of the four varieties of
dramatic style, the graceful style, suited especially to the passion
of love.
 n. (-कं) A quantity of hair, the head of hair.
 E. केशिक hav-
ing much hair. &c. affix अण् fem. affix ङीष्.

कैशोर n. (-रं) Youth, boyhood, from the age of ten to that of fifteen.
E. किशोर a child, and अञ् aff.

कैश्य n. (-श्यं) A head of hair, much or ornamented hair.
 E. केश hair,
यञ् aff.
